issues.requirement_quote: In UrbanMode, the system begins in the enter_urban substate.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The edge reaches the required target and may be part of a compiler-generated route protocol, but the supplied facts do not prove that conditional entry fulfills the author's initial-entry statement.
issues.title: UrbanMode default entry is conditional

issues.basis: NL10; source transition tr_0026; closed transition:line:102; source/model binding for FinishState; transition fact comparison.
issues.expected: A transition from UrbanMode to FinishState exists on auto_finished=true.
issues.observed: The closed transition:line:102 has source UrbanMode, trigger auto_finished_true, and target HighwayMode; FinishState is state:FinishState:line:21.
issues.reason: The source requires UrbanMode to transition to FinishState, but the exact closed transition with auto_finished_true targets HighwayMode rather than the uniquely bound FinishState state.
issues.requirement_quote: The system exits the UrbanMode state by transitioning to FinishState once `auto_finished=true` is satisfied.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The closed model contains a separate AutonomousMode-to-HighwayMode transition with an effect token that can route to FinishState, but that is not the exact UrbanMode-to-FinishState edge required by the contract.
issues.title: UrbanMode completion targets the wrong closed state

issues.basis: NL12; source/model bindings for CollisionAvoidance and both child states; transition:line:93; deterministic diagnostics EVENT_CONSUMER_UNREACHABLE and STATE_UNREACHABLE_FROM_INITIAL; verify refutation of the activation event-consumer check.
issues.expected: The activation event has a reachable consumer in the collision avoidance operating scope.
issues.observed: transition:line:93 is the sole activation consumer, but reachable_consumer_transition_refs is empty; CollisionAvoidance state:line:89 and its child states are unreachable.
issues.reason: The exact activation transition exists and is declared in the required collision-avoidance scope, but its source composite and consumer state are unreachable from a top-level initial entry. The causal issue is therefore operational consumer coverage, represented by the branch-local derived contract.
issues.requirement_quote: It transitions to collision_avoidance_active when certain conditions are met, such as detecting pedestrians (`pedestrian_detected`), the rear distance being less than 5 meters with a velocity over 30 km/h (`dist_to_rear<5 & vel>30`), or the front distance being less than 15 meters in highway mode or 10 meters in urban mode.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The collision-avoidance initial edge and activation transition are structurally present, so a future execution model with an external entry into CollisionAvoidance could reach them; the supplied finite closed-model facts show no such top-level entry.
issues.title: Collision avoidance activation scope is unreachable

issues.basis: NL12 requires the collision avoidance system to be initially active in its deactive state. The closed model has exact CollisionAvoidance and collision_avoidance_deactive refs, but deterministic reachability facts mark both the composite and its leaves unreachable from any top-level initial entry.
issues.expected: CollisionAvoidance is reachable from the model's top-level initial entry so its required operating behavior can execute.
issues.observed: CollisionAvoidance at state:CollisionAvoidance:line:89 is not reachable from a top-level initial entry; its collision-avoidance leaves are likewise unreachable.
issues.reason: The derived global reachability obligation is independently exposed by the source-required collision-avoidance scope and the exact closed finite reachability result.
issues.requirement_quote: The collision avoidance system is initially in the collision_avoidance_deactive state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The closed model contains a local initial edge to collision_avoidance_deactive, but that edge is owned by CollisionAvoidance and the enclosing composite itself has no top-level entry; local declaration and local initial structure therefore do not establish root reachability.
issues.title: Collision avoidance scope is unreachable

issues.basis: NL12 explicitly requires the collision avoidance system to start in collision_avoidance_deactive. The exact owner-local initial edge exists from the CollisionAvoidance pseudostate to the exact target, but the owner composite is not root-reachable; the owner-local edge therefore does not establish the required system startup behavior.
issues.expected: The CollisionAvoidance scope initially enters collision_avoidance_deactive.
issues.observed: The owner-local edge transition:line:92 reaches collision_avoidance_deactive, but CollisionAvoidance is unreachable from a top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The local edge is correctly targeted, but the broader owner-level startup obligation is not closed because the owner has no root entry. The registry's S2 cannot express this scoped default-entry-plus-root-reachability condition.
issues.requirement_quote: The collision avoidance system is initially in the collision_avoidance_deactive state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The exact local initial edge exists and is unguarded, so a purely local initial-edge predicate would pass; the remaining issue concerns the enclosing system's absence from root reachability.
issues.title: Collision avoidance startup is not operationally reachable

issues.basis: NL12 requires the collision avoidance activation transition. Its exact source and target states and transition carrier are present, with the declared composite and leaf scope confirmed by source/model mappings. No endpoint violation is emitted; the unreachable-scope issue is reported separately.
issues.expected: A transition from collision_avoidance_deactive to collision_avoidance_active exists and can participate in the required collision-avoidance behavior.
issues.observed: The exact transition exists, but its consumer state and transition are not reachable from a top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The endpoint property itself is satisfied, but its operational consequence is not globally available because the enclosing collision-avoidance scope is unreachable. The original endpoint contract is not changed into a different property.
issues.requirement_quote: It transitions to collision_avoidance_active when certain conditions are met, such as detecting pedestrians (`pedestrian_detected`), the rear distance being less than 5 meters with a velocity over 30 km/h (`dist_to_rear<5 & vel>30`), or the front distance being less than 15 meters in highway mode or 10 meters in urban mode.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The exact closed transition and its trigger projection are present; only root reachability prevents the transition from being operationally exercised in the closed hierarchy.
issues.title: Activation transition is declared but unreachable

issues.basis: NL13 requires the collision avoidance recovery transition. Its exact source and target states and transition carrier are present, but deterministic event-consumer facts show no reachable consumer from a top-level initial entry.
issues.expected: A transition from collision_avoidance_active to collision_avoidance_deactive exists and can participate in the required recovery behavior.
issues.observed: The exact transition exists, but its consumer state and transition are not reachable from a top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The endpoint property is satisfied; the distinct operational reachability gap is retained as evidence rather than changing the endpoint contract's semantic key.
issues.requirement_quote: Once in the collision_avoidance_active state, the collision avoidance system returns to the collision_avoidance_deactive state when there is no active danger, as indicated by the conditions `front_inactive`, `rear_inactive`, and `pedestrian_inactive`.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The exact recovery transition exists and carries the required trigger; the remaining defect is solely that the enclosing collision-avoidance scope is unreachable.
issues.title: Recovery transition is declared but unreachable

issues.basis: NL6 requires HighwayMode to terminate at FinishState. The exact completion endpoint exists, but the closed model also has HighwayMode self-continuation and routes from the active HighwayMode scope into UrbanMode, so the supplied target edge does not prove stable termination.
issues.expected: When HighwayMode completes, execution stably terminates at FinishState without re-entering or continuing operating behavior.
issues.observed: HighwayMode has a completion carrier to FinishState, but also has parent-level self-transitions at transition:line:98 and transition:line:103 and a route to UrbanMode at transition:line:100; the active ancestor can continue or re-enter behavior.
issues.reason: The exact termination target and active-ancestor continuation facts show that endpoint existence is weaker than the required stable termination property, which is not expressible by the frozen endpoint predicates.
issues.requirement_quote: The HighwayMode ends when the system transitions to FinishState, triggered by the `auto_finished=true` condition.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: FinishState is an exact target of transition:line:27 and the completion trigger exists, but those facts establish entry only and do not remove the supplied parent-level continuation edges.
issues.title: HighwayMode does not establish stable termination

issues.basis: NL10 requires UrbanMode to terminate at FinishState. The exact carrier exists, but it targets FinishState within HighwayMode and the closed model retains an active HighwayMode continuation/self-transition after that route, so stable termination is not established.
issues.expected: When UrbanMode completes, execution stably terminates at FinishState without entering continued HighwayMode behavior.
issues.observed: The UrbanMode completion carrier transition:line:26 targets HighwayMode.FinishState, while parent-level transitions:line:101 and transition:line:102 continue from UrbanMode to HighwayMode.
issues.reason: The target edge exists, but its ancestry and active-ancestor continuation are inconsistent with stable termination; no frozen predicate precisely represents this termination semantics.
issues.requirement_quote: The system exits the UrbanMode state by transitioning to FinishState once `auto_finished=true` is satisfied.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The closed model contains an exact auto_finished=true completion carrier to FinishState; the issue is the stronger stability requirement, not endpoint existence.
issues.title: UrbanMode does not establish stable termination
